report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-100ms durations except one 344ms outlier; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is 437ms with zero 502s. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) and memory retention well under limits. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; the alert's latency signal is mild and not corroborated by failures.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (excluded ev-...-gw-logs) to check for errors or retries during the 344ms request
Per-dependency latency metrics for order/inventory/payment to localize the slow span
Baseline p95 for /v1/checkout to judge whether 437ms is anomalous
Confirmation whether the 344ms outlier is the incident trigger or normal variance
